:::{#exr-scalar-transpose-practice}
#### Evaluating a product of a vector, a matrix and a vector

@thm-scalar-transpose turns $\tp{\vecf{v}}\,\tp{\matr{M}}\,\vecf{u}$ back into $\tp{\vecf{u}}\matr{M}\vecf{v}$,
which can be the easier [product](#def-matrix-mult) of a vector, a [matrix](#def-matrix) and a vector to compute.
Let

$$
\vecf{u} = \sbmat{1 \\ -1},
\qquad
\vecf{v} = \sbmat{2 \\ 3},
\qquad
\matr{M} = \sbmat{0 & 1 \\ 2 & 0}.
$$

Find $\tp{\vecf{v}}\,\tp{\matr{M}}\,\vecf{u}$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

By @thm-scalar-transpose,
it is enough to compute $\tp{\vecf{u}}\matr{M}\vecf{v}$.

:::

:::
